name: automate interactive console configuration of the guest
definition: Drive the guest console non-interactively (typing login commands and configuration through a serial console) to set up the operating system.
failure_mode: Without console automation, the guest never reaches a configured, running state.

name: complete formal proofs that type-check with no placeholders
definition: replace stub identifications with valid tactic/lemma sequences in interactive theorem-style files
failure_mode: any remaining placeholder or an invalid proof makes the file fail compilation

name: drive an interactive program-mode debugger by feeding line commands on stdin
definition: Use a piped sequence of debugger commands so the tool steps through instructions and shows the execution trace.
failure_mode: Debugger not built/hings, missing some treated in linked IPC.

name: play a text-adventure/terminal game to its ending via interpreter or stdin
definition: Drive an interactive text-adventure or terminal game (frotz interpreter or stdin, optionally minimal-actions) to the completion ending and record the exact ending message.
failure_mode: failing to enter/create the character or never entering combat leaves the fight-count/news assertions failing
